_note: Relics. Each effect key is summed across owned relics; see sim/run_state.gd mod().

golden_idol.name: Golden Idol
golden_idol.text: Heroes earn 50% extra from bounties (paid by the gods, not you).

blood_pact.name: Blood Pact
blood_pact.text: Heroes deal +4 damage. Keep -30 max HP.

piggy_bank.name: Piggy Bank
piggy_bank.text: +4 gold per round for every round you have owned it.

courage_charm.name: Courage Charm
courage_charm.text: Heroes +10 max HP and retreat later.

recruiting_poster.name: Recruiting Poster
recruiting_poster.text: A free hero joins now. Recruiting costs 15 less.

sanctuary_bell.name: Sanctuary Bell
sanctuary_bell.text: Heroes heal fully between rounds and 3x faster at the keep.

lucky_coin.name: Lucky Coin
lucky_coin.text: Every kill drops +2 gold for the hero.
